description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named WindowFocusObserver, which monitors focus changes on the window using a custom FocusObserver. It also manages UI elements like SearchView and ShareActionProvider, and updates a TextView based on focus events.

classes.name: WindowFocusObserver
classes.description: An Android activity that observes window focus changes using WindowId.FocusObserver, updates UI based on focus state, and manages search and share functionalities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and finds the focus state TextView.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu, sets up SearchView query listener, and configures sharing intent via ShareActionProvider.

methods.name: onSort
methods.description: Placeholder method for menu item sort action.

methods.name: onQueryTextChange
methods.description: Handles changes in search query text.

methods.name: onQueryTextSubmit
methods.description: Handles search query submission, displaying a Toast message.

methods.name: onAttachedToWindow
methods.description: Registers the focus observer and updates UI with current focus state.
